name: Procurement - Intent to Execute
attribution: Office of the Chief Procurement Officer

Detailed Descriptive.Data notes: Detailed MBE/WBE Codes: African American = 6 or AA; Caucasian Female = 7 or CF; Asian (or Asian American/Pacific Islander) = 8 or AAPI; Hispanic = 9 or HA; Native American = 4

columns.name: Posting Date
columns.description: date that the contract opportunity was made publicly available

columns.name: Contract Number
columns.description: unique contract identifier issued by the Office of the Chief Procurement Officer

columns.name: Department
columns.description: Cook County department or agency receiving supplies or services outlined by contract

columns.name: Description
columns.description: description of goods, supplies, and/or services provided by the contract

columns.name: Contract Amount
columns.description: amount agreed to be paid by the County for the contract

columns.name: Recommended Vendor
columns.description: vendor to be awarded the contract; for competitive bids, this is the vendor with the lowest responsive and responsible bid as selected by the Chief Procurement Officer

columns.name: MBE/WBE/DBE Participation
columns.description: indicates whether the vendor is a participating minority business (MBE), women's business (WBE), and/or (economically) disadvantaged business (DBE) enterprise; values may be "0" or "waived" for vendors that are not participating or for projects without contractual participation of a MBE, WBE, or VBE; in some instances where the recommended vendor is using a MBE/WBE/DBE subcontractor, the subcontractor name may be populated

columns.name: MBE/WBE/DBE type
columns.description: specifies how the enterprise qualifies as an MBE, WBE, or DBE in greater detail; see Data notes for more information

columns.name: Direct Participation
columns.description: percentage of contract amount that is allocated to work performed in direct relation to the scope of the contract

columns.name: Indirect Participation
columns.description: percentage of contract amount that is allocated to work performed that indirectly supports the scope of the contract
